newsitem.title: POLAND: Court clears sale of Prochnik stake.
newsitem.headline: Court clears sale of Prochnik stake.

text.p: A district court in the central Polish city of Lodz cleared the sale of 149,999 shares or some 10 percent of garment maker Prochnik SA to National Investment Fund No. 12 "Piast", a judge said on Monday.
The shares come from a 380,881-share stake of Prochnik which had been held by the Westa insurance company and which went into receivership after Westa's bankruptcy.
"The court has allowed the receiver of the Westa insurer to sell 149,999 common shares of Prochnik to NFI Piast at 11 zlotys per share," Jacek Pasikowski told Reuters.
The sale of the Prochnik stake had to be cleared by court because NFI 12 was the only bidder in a tender for the shares and under Polish law there have to be at least two bidders.
